title: Psalm 55 (O God, Please Listen)
lyrics_original: O God, please listen to my prayer;
My anxious thoughts make me distraught;
I’m troubled by the voice of foes,
For they bring suf-fer-ing to me
Within me anguish grips my heart;
“O that I, like a dove, had wings!
And be at rest; I’d flee from here
Far from the raging of the storm
Distressed, I cry— He hears my voice.
From battle waged by many foes,
Those men who have no fear of God
O cast your burden on the LORD,
And he will care for you;
He’ll never let the righteous fall,
author_english: Sing, Psalms 2003 The Free Church of Scotland

bible_verses.english: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my plea. Pay attention to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan.
My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me. Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me. Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

devotional.prayer_english: Heavenly Father, thank You that I do not have to hide my anxious thoughts or pretend to be strong before You. Please listen to my prayer today and quiet the storm raging within my heart. When anguish grips my soul, remind me that You are my safe refuge and faithful deliverer. I cast all my cares into Your loving hands, trusting that You will hold me steady. In Jesus' name, Amen.

devotional.reflection_english: Life often brings seasons where anxiety weighs heavily on our hearts and the noise of distress feels overwhelming. Like the psalmist, we are invited to bring our raw, unfiltered pain directly to God, knowing He never turns a deaf ear to our cries. Jesus understands the deepest anguish of the human soul, having borne our greatest sorrows on the cross. As you sing, lay down the burdens you were never meant to carry alone, trusting that the Lord hears you and will sustain you.
